# Mike Danielson | HealthCar

> HealthCar is Mike Danielson’s strategic advisory practice for nutrition and health commercialization: strategy, execution, partnerships, and applied AI.

Mike Danielson is a strategic advisor with 35 years in nutrition and health: hundreds of product launches, dozens of branded ingredients (including the launch of Wellmune beta-glucan as a branded ingredient), and client relationships measured in decades. He is the founder of HealthCar LLC (Minneapolis, Minnesota) and advises ingredient innovators across the US, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Mike Danielson is the primary entity; HealthCar is the practice he founded.

- [Contact](https://healthcar.co/contact/): Book a 30-minute conversation.

## Key facts
- Founder: Mike Danielson. Practice: HealthCar LLC. Location: Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA.
- Services: Strategic Advisory for Strategy & Execution; Client Representation; Partnership & Business Development; AI, Applied.
- Philosophy: Serve first, success follows. Brand before marketing. Marketing before the promotional mix. Proof before promise.
